mostWorthwhile.text: Asking Moth about the rejection was most worthwhile: its cached map showed how an outdated directory can perpetuate an error about a real neighborhood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cleaning the contacts and replacing the ribbon were clear but predictable sequential repairs, with little decision-making once the faults were identified.

surprise.text: Moth treated the neighborhood as a service gap even though it visibly exists, showing that the assistant relied on its flawed directory.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the repairs and connections had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. I'd like to see how the neighbors challenge the faulty directory; Moth's confident reliance on it gives the story an intriguing problem to pursue.
